I always had to jump through hoops and modify DNS entries (SRV, TXT, etc.) and other settings to comply with various mail gateway policies when they rejected my outgoing mail. I'd get nasty-grams from ISPs and mail providers all the time because of my mail server "reputation" being low or non-existent. I had to do whatever their policy asked for to be able to send email to that host/gateway. In the end it just wasn't worth doing it myself. This was ten years ago so I can't imagine how much worse it's gotten now.
